title_en: Ah Huang at Half Past Five
note_en: 连…也/都… means "even": after 连 comes the most surprising example, and 也 or 都 before the verb confirms it is included. In the text: 全村的人都起晚了，连小学生上学也迟到了 "the whole village overslept; even the schoolchildren were late"; 连天边光线一点点的变化都能感觉到 "it can sense even the slightest change of light on the horizon." English just uses "even," but Chinese needs both halves.
